pcs_sets.note: total abdominal hysterectomy (uterus + cervix) with bladder fistula repair

rationale: Open hysterectomy coded as Resection of uterus and cervix (separate body parts) plus open Repair of bladder for the fistula closure, a distinct objective.
Closing the open bladder plate restores its structure without a device or transfer = Repair of bladder, open; Reposition is the other plausible root if the plate is mobilized into the pelvis.

pcs_sets.note: ileocystoplasty; ileal segment harvest coded separately

rationale: Augmentation with a bowel patch = Supplement of bladder with autologous tissue; the ileal segment taken for the graft is a separate body part so its Excision is coded per B3.9; bowel anastomosis not coded.
Creating a bladder-to-skin stoma = Bypass bladder to cutaneous, open.

pcs_sets.note: substitution urethroplasty with buccal mucosa graft plus graft harvest

rationale: One-stage posterior urethroplasty is usually excision of the stenotic segment with end-to-end anastomosis (Excision of urethra, open); graft-augmented repairs are Supplement with the buccal donor site coded separately per B3.9.
Taking out the infected device and placing a new one = Removal plus Insertion of artificial sphincter at the cuff site; irrigation not coded and debridement coded only if documented as excisional.
Endarterectomy = Extirpation of matter; the profunda femoris falls under the femoral artery body part; a patch closure is coded as Supplement when documented.

pcs_sets.note: re-exploration with thrombectomy, right internal carotid
re-exploration with thrombectomy, left internal carotid

rationale: Return to the neck for postoperative bleeding = Control of bleeding in neck (B3.7); for postoperative thrombosis the clot removal is Extirpation of the carotid; exploration with no intervention would be Inspection.
TIPS = percutaneous Bypass portal vein to hepatic vein with synthetic substitute (FY2025+ hepatic-vein qualifier).
Tying off a vessel completely = Occlusion, open; body part per artery ligated; the indication mix (graft infection, hemorrhage, aneurysm) is uncertain.

The tumor replaces the carotid body and the whole body is removed = Resection of carotid body, open (Excision if partial); carotid body dx sits in MDC 1 whose OR list lacks 0GT6/0GT7, so it groups 981-983.

pcs_sets.note: right, with internal carotid segment excision
left, with internal carotid segment excision

rationale: Resection of carotid body plus Excision of the involved internal carotid segment (distinct body part); if the segment is reconstructed with a graft, Replacement of the carotid replaces the Excision code.
